fact: On 28-30 May 2024 MINPOSTEL and the Council of Europe held a Yaoundé workshop of about 70 participants, including private sector representatives, on the findings of the assessment of Cameroon's cybercrime and cybersecurity framework, where stakeholders asked that Internet service providers and civil society be involved in consultations on the new cybercrime law.
title: GLACY-e: Advisory mission on supporting the legislative reform on cybercrime and electronic evidence and 24/7 Point of Contact (POC)
